evidence.text: In ve33/contracts/GovernanceHYBR.sol, `deposit()` locks the incoming HYBR into the veNFT first and then calculates gHYBR shares. `calculateShares` reads `totalAssets` after it already includes the new deposit. The effective formula becomes `shares = amount * totalSupply / (assets_before + amount)`. This inflates the denominator with the depositor’s own funds and causes minting less shares than expected.

links.reported_relation: deposit() locks funds then calculates shares from post-deposit totalAssets, inflating the denominator and minting fewer (worst case zero) shares than the pre-deposit snapshot would yield.
